messages:
Nina H: quick brainstorming — proposing a tiny 'cost origin' pill for the rollout rail that shows Effective tokens (est) + a one-click breakdown. want to stop PMs from treating it as invoice-ready.
Carlos M: +1. We need provenance fields: sample_rate, calc_version, and a confidence % so people don't misinterpret.
Priya D: backend reality: we can emit per-route `gross_tokens` and `kv_hit_count` in the 1m rollup. estimating savings = kv_hit_count * model_avg_cached_tokens (from histograms). cheap and fast.
Nina H: ok. UX: show main number as "Effective tokens (est)" and small chevron -> panel with: Gross / Est savings / kv_hits / provenance. Keep copy micro.
Carlos M: edge: shared prefetch keys will double count. suggest we emit `shared_prefetch_flag` when same cache_key observed across >1 route in hour. show a yellow badge if true.
Priya D: implementation: rollup emits `gross_tokens`, `kv_hits`, `sample_rate`, `calc_v`, `shared_prefetch_flag`. CI for estimate computed via bootstrap on sampled histograms; include ±% band.
Nina H: rollout: feature flag -> internal dogfood -> dark-launch to 10% org -> compare nightly recon. If median error < 20% for 48h we enable.
Carlos M: runbook snippet: if card spikes but billing flat -> 1) check `shared_prefetch_flag` 2) check routing sticky and warmup windows 3) run offline recon: `/ops/cost/recon?route=...` 4) increase sampling for that route.
Priya D: will open backend PR for rollup + provenance tags. Frontend PR will read tags and render the panel. Tagging deploy-bot for canary.
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for branch "eng/mini-cost-origin" to staging at 2024-10-02T10:00:00Z :rocket:
Nina H: thanks — i'll draft tooltip copy and a short doc about "estimated" semantics. leaving thread open for PR links. :seedling:
